audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer rated Level 1 as 'Graves 8/10' while the content layer and the packet levelChart both give Level 1 to Ryze. Three sources disagreed.
audit.why: Graves' shotgun is point-blank (Passive: 4 bullets that cannot pass through units) and his only gap-closer, Quickdraw (E, 425 range), is not available until level 3. Ryze's Overload is 1000 range on a 5s cooldown. Emerald+ win rate is 44%, matching a losing early lane.
audit.corrected: Level chart set to the packet: Ryze / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill / Ryze, with phase whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was rated 'Skill 4/10' in the full layer but described in content as Graves' kill button; the first-item spike was described as a Graves peak in one layer and a coin flip in the other.
audit.why: Collateral Damage (R) is 100/80/60s and deals heavy single-target damage plus a cone — combined with the E dash it is a genuine kill spike at 6. Ryze has no shield and no escape, only Realm Warp (R, 180/160/140s) which is a relocation, not a dodge.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Graves; first item is Skill (his Tear scaling ramps into it); 2+ items is Ryze.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics repeated across early/mid/late/whys/spikes/wants: (a) Rune Prison is called Ryze's E root — it is his W; Spell Flux is E. (b) Smoke Screen is said to blind Ryze's autoattacks — Riot's text gives it sight-range reduction, magic damage and a brief slow, with no blind at all.
audit.why: Riot text, Ryze W: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' 615 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Ryze E (Spell Flux, 3.5-2.5s) applies the debuff. Graves W (Smoke Screen, 26/24/22/20/18s, 950 range) reduces sight range and slows on impact — no blind. Advice built on a blind that does not exist would get players killed.
audit.corrected: All references corrected to Rune Prison (W), root conditional on Spell Flux (E) landing first, and Smoke Screen described as sight-cut plus slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining cooldown was named but never numbered.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s; Overload is a flat 5s and is reset by his other casts, so Overload is never the punish window — Rune Prison is.
audit.corrected: Cooldown text now states 9-11s and the Flux-first ordering.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Smoke Screen's' as a probable wrong name. It is a false positive — Smoke Screen is Graves' real W name.
audit.corrected: No name change; the sentence was rewritten only because it asserted a blind effect the ability does not have.

edits.before: Ryze owns Levels 1-2 — his Q, Overload, outranges your point-blank 4-shell spread, so every time you walk up to last-hit he pokes you for free and you can't shoot back. Don't trade through it; grab safe CS with the tip of your shots and reload behind minions. At Level 3 you finally get Quickdraw (E): now you can dash in and drop Smoke Screen on him, which blinds his autoattacks and slashes his vision range so he struggles to land his next Q. Be careful — Smoke's blind only stops his autos, not his spell damage, so it doesn't blank his combo. The thing to respect is his E root (Rune Prison): if he lands it you eat the full Q-E-Q rotation, so only commit when that root is on cooldown.
edits.after: Ryze owns Levels 1-2 — Overload reaches 1000 units against your point-blank 4-shell spread, so every time you walk up to last-hit he pokes you for free and you can't shoot back. Don't trade through it; grab safe CS with the tip of your shots and reload behind minions. At Level 3 Quickdraw (E) arrives: a 425 dash in, then Smoke Screen slows him and cuts his sight range so he loses track of where your step-up is coming from. It does not blind — the sight cut is the whole effect, and almost none of his damage is autos anyway. Respect Rune Prison: it is his W, 9-11 seconds, and it only roots if Spell Flux (E) is already on you, so breaking that order kills the rotation.

edits.before: This is your one real window. Through Levels 4-5 your True Grit armor/MR stacking and two Quickdraw charges let you survive an extended trade, but his Q-E-Q burst is still real, so go in only when his E root is down. At 6, Collateral Damage is the play: E in, throw Smoke Screen to cut his vision and blind his autos, then R + Q + autos for the burst. His shield and Q resets mean a half-commit just feeds him mana stacks — land the whole combo or don't go in. Your first item (Eclipse/Youmuu's) is your hard peak: force every all-in here, because this is the last point where you out-stat him before his scaling takes over.
edits.after: This is your one real window. Through Levels 4-5 your True Grit armor/MR stacking and two Quickdraw charges let you survive an extended trade, but his Flux-into-Overload burst is real, so go in only when Rune Prison (W) is down — 9 seconds at rank 5. At 6, Collateral Damage is the play: E in, Smoke Screen to cut his sight range, then R + Q + autos for the burst. Overload is a 5-second cooldown that his other casts reset, so a half-commit just feeds him free damage — land the whole combo or don't go in. Your first item (Eclipse/Youmuu's) is your hard peak: force every all-in here, the last point where you out-stat him.

edits.before: You lose the long game, full stop. By 2+ items Ryze has Tear into Archangel's, his Overload spam costs almost nothing and resets off his combo endlessly, and his E root locks you from range before Quickdraw can carry you out — your armor stacking means nothing against a mana-fed mage who never lets you into shotgun range. Smoke Screen's blind does zero against his ability damage, which is all of it. Your only path is to have already won: snowball the Level 3-6 and first-item windows into a lead, then group and force the game before his realm-warp roams and raid-boss scaling take over. If it's even at 25+ minutes, you've already lost.
edits.after: You lose the long game, full stop. By 2+ items Ryze has Tear into Archangel's, his Overload spam costs almost nothing and resets off his combo endlessly, and Rune Prison roots you at 615 before Quickdraw can carry you out — your armor stacking means nothing against a mana-fed mage who never lets you into shotgun range. Smoke Screen only cuts sight range and slows; it removes none of his damage. Your only path is to have already won: snowball the Level 3-6 and first-item windows into a lead, then group and force the game before Realm Warp roams and raid-boss scaling take over. If it's even at 25+ minutes, you've already lost.

notes: Packet defect 'Smoke Screen's' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Smoke Screen is Graves' real W name. The genuine errors were mechanical: Rune Prison was called Ryze's E throughout (it is W; E is Spell Flux, and the root only fires if Flux is already applied), Smoke Screen was credited with a blind it does not have, and Ryze was credited with a shield he does not have. Level chart was contradictory across three sources and is now aligned to the packet chart, which also matches the 44% Emerald+ win rate. phases[2].rating is submitted unchanged to keep the level-chart flip an atomic group.
